MODULE: frontend/metadata_guard.py -- the LEARNER-VISIBLE public-metadata ISOLATION-CONTRACT
validator (`validate_public_metadata` -> `_validate_keys` recursion) plus the axis1 static-ZZ
public normalizers. It imports NEITHER torch NOR quimb (collections.abc + math + plain
dict/f-string only), so EVERY public unit is CPU-PURE and IN-SCOPE for full L0+L1+L2 --
out_of_scope is therefore {} (the AST reconcile refuses any gpu_bound claim on a torch-less
module -> expect ZERO out_of_scope).
FOUR public units (AST reconcile _public_units_in_module: top-level public defs; NO classes):
* validate_public_metadata         -- copy + `_validate_keys` fail-closed reserved-key reject
* normalize_axis1_static_zz_couplings   -- canonical/sorted/deduped two-qubit edge list
* normalize_axis1_static_zz_calibrations -- per-edge zeta/epistemic-class calibration map
* axis1_static_zz_calibrations_to_manifest -- JSON-safe deterministic calibration records
The private recursion engine `_validate_keys` (is_root / allow_audit_transport params) and the
helpers `_static_zz_calibration_records_from_mapping` / `_static_zz_calibration_records_from_
sequence` / `_parse_static_zz_edge_key` are NOT public units (leading `_`), so the coverage
audit does not score them -- but they ARE mutated by mutmut and are exercised end-to-end through
the public entry points (every dict/list/scalar recursion arm + every raising guard, tripped
through EVERY route that reaches it with the EXACT message).
L2 DISCIPLINE (100% coverage != discrimination) + THE ISOLATION-CONTRACT KILLERS.
This module was JUST HARDENED (commit 9db34a7): `_validate_keys` now recurses FAIL-CLOSED and
rejects a NESTED `_source_projection_evaluator_audit` key while allowing the declared TOP-LEVEL
audit transport ONLY under allow_evaluator_audit_transport=True. Tested at its NEW state:
* A clean public metadata dict PASSES and is returned as a distinct COPY (pinned == input).
* EVERY reserved key is REJECTED with the EXACT message via assert_raises_exact: all 8
_RESERVED_METADATA_EXACT_KEYS and all 31 _RESERVED_METADATA_KEY_PARTS are tripped one-per-
call (independent HARDCODED key lists -- NOT imported from src, so a mutated src constant no
longer matches the hardcoded key -> no raise -> the exact-message pin fails -> mutant killed).
* Key normalization (`.lower()`/`.replace('-','_')`/`.replace(' ','_')`) is killed by
upper-case / hyphen / space variants of a reserved key that must still normalize to a match.
* TOP-LEVEL `_source_projection_evaluator_audit`: ALLOWED (returned unchanged) only under
allow_evaluator_audit_transport=True; REJECTED with the exact 'cannot carry' message under
the default (fail-closed). Both pinned -> kills the allow-default=False and the is_root/allow
`and` mutants.
* THE KILLER (the D18 finding, now fixed): a NESTED audit key inside a SUB-DICT and inside a
LIST element is REJECTED fail-closed with the exact 'cannot nest' message (the recursion
reaches it at is_root=False -> line-283 branch), and a nested audit key is NOT rescued even
with allow_evaluator_audit_transport=True (allow applies only at the root). assert_
discriminates against a clean-nested control (same dict/list shape, no audit key) that does
NOT raise. This kills the line-303 `is_root=False`->`True` mutant (which would emit the
'cannot carry' top-level message instead) and the line-268 `if is_root` mutants.
* normalize_axis1_static_zz_couplings / _calibrations: every normalized output pinned vs an
INDEPENDENT recompute (sorted-canonical-deduped edges; sorted calibration map with float
zeta + default epistemic_class 'c'); every validation guard tripped through EVERY route with
the exact message (bad-edge type via BOTH `or` operands, len!=2, duplicate endpoint,
negative endpoint, out-of-range at the q==nq boundary, non-positive num_qubits at the nq==0
boundary, duplicate edge, undeclared edge, duplicate calibration, non-finite/negative zeta
via BOTH `or` operands at the zeta==0 boundary, bad epistemic_class, mapping-key parse via
str/sequence/neither routes, sequence-record 'edge'/'qubits' fallback + missing edge/zeta).
* axis1_static_zz_calibrations_to_manifest: the EXACT manifest list pinned (None/{} -> [];
non-empty dict kills the `calibrations or {}` -> `and` mutant, for which the None input alone
is equivalent since normalize(None)==normalize({})==[]).
REACHABILITY (the D13/D18/D19 default-arg / guard-route lesson -- PROBED through the public entry
point, never asserted). `_validate_keys` has dict + list/tuple + scalar arms: all three are
exercised (nested reserved keys reached via a sub-DICT value AND via a LIST element; scalar
values recurse to the no-op arm). A raising guard is tripped through EVERY route reaching it, and
each `or`/`and` guard is probed with a NON-str NON-Sequence value (int) where a str (iterable)
could not expose an `or`<->`and` swap. NO exemptions + NO out_of_scope: every unit is CPU-pure
and every branch is REACHABLE through a public entry point (checked, not assumed).
